facts.claim: Apple and Google both charge 15% on the first 1 million dollars of annual revenue and 30% above it, plus a 99 dollar and 25 dollar developer fee
facts.source_title: The 15% App Store Fee: A Guide for Developers
facts.excerpt: Apple App Store costs $99/year plus 15% for revenue under $1M/year, 30% above. Google Play charges $25 once plus 15% on first $1M/year, 30% above.

facts.claim: From 1 January 2026 Apple replaced the per-install Core Technology Fee with a 5% Core Technology Commission on digital-goods revenue
facts.source_title: App Store Fees and Commission Rates in 2026
facts.excerpt: From January 1, 2026, Apple replaced the per-install Core Technology Fee with a 5% Core Technology Commission on digital-goods revenue.

facts.claim: UPI Autopay is reported at 92% or better mandate success for recurring debits under Rs 15,000
facts.source_title: UPI Autopay vs Card e-Mandates: 2026 Decision Guide
facts.excerpt: UPI Autopay mandates are showing 92%+ mandate success rates for recurring payments under Rs 15,000

facts.claim: 37% of B2B software companies now run a hybrid pricing model, up from 25% twelve months earlier
facts.source_title: The 2026 State of B2B SaaS and AI Monetization Report
facts.excerpt: About two-in-five participants (37%) said they have a hybrid pricing model, up from 25% twelve months ago.

facts.claim: Seat-based contracts still account for 65% to 75% of software spend while consumption-based pricing sits at 4% to 6%
facts.source_title: From seats to consumption: why SaaS pricing has entered its hybrid era
facts.excerpt: Seat-based contracts account for 65-75% of spend, and consumption-based pricing is stuck at 4-6%.

facts.claim: All-in international payment cost for Indian businesses spans 0.5% to 1.2% via virtual export accounts and 6% to 8.5% via legacy wallet aggregators
facts.source_title: International Payment Processing Cost in India 2026
facts.excerpt: True all-in cost ranges from 0.5 to 1.2 percent via virtual export accounts to 6 to 8.5 percent via legacy global wallet aggregators.
